question: Which named kalas are enumerated in this portion of the lunar series?
premises: Kanti, Jyotsna, Shri, Priti, and Angada are named
These form part of the enumerated kalas
inference: This portion enumerates Shashini, Candrika, Kanti, Jyotsna, Shri, Priti, and Angada.
uncertainties: The form śīḥ is unusual and may be a variant of śrīḥ.
plain_english: Shashini, Candrika, Kanti, Jyotsna, Shri, Priti, and Angada.
